support_interpretation: tunnel/cong+VRF camps: only 57 tunnel_degradation rows vs 1224 vrf_leakage — trees rarely learn to keep VRF when tunnel-traffic features are also hot (and vice versa for quiet BGP under VRF-like traffic signatures). bgp+VRF focus: 189 bgp_route_flap vs 1104 vrf_leakage — better but still thin for the specific simultaneous pairing. This is a support/campaign problem, not a threshold tweak.

what_would_fix_at_source.model_side_not_recommended_now: Per-class threshold reweight / inverse-frequency on whole head will not revive a near-zero class score. Feature-importance upweight of orthogonal cols would require a retrain (Tier-B style), not tune_thresholds alone.
what_would_fix_at_source.recommended_next: Small dedicated compound campaign focused on (1) tunnel@s1 + VRF@s2 with enough frames where both orthogonal and traffic features co-move, and (2) BGP@s1 + VRF@s2 with clear bgp_flap_count dynamics — then a mixed retrain. Do not promote from this dry-run.
what_would_fix_at_source.instrumentation_if_needed: Mirror bgp_flap_count exporter on station2 only if blinds will place BGP injection on station2; current scoreboard compounds do not need it for the station1 BGP leg.

honest_bottom_line: Needle does not move in this experiment because the eligible fix class (present-but-outvoted → threshold/class-weight machinery) does not match the failure mode. Both recorded misses are zeroed-out under live-faithful scoring despite populated orthogonal exporters. Next lever is compound training support (small dedicated campaign + retrain), not tune_thresholds.
